proposition.claim:
The signature criterion applies to the full stated parameter range.

Arbitrary power substitution preserves irreducibility under Proposition 7 hypotheses.

Full characteristic polynomial of every preceding low-degree construction is irreducible and gives Perron-square-root minimal polynomial.

repair.content:
Restrict chosen low-degree subfamily to a retained leaf parameter <=3 and large remaining parameters, or supply another proof for unrestricted parameters.

Require a nonzero simple eigenvalue and apply Eisenstein at an irreducible factor of its squarefree substituted minimal polynomial.

Use Perron factor / equal-leaf quotient retaining multiplicity in coupling; treat d1 by duplicating a separating curve twice.
